title: 第六章：地球移民者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏行枫昏迷了一天了，到现在都还没醒过来。

“小强啊，你下手也太重了吧！这个家伙到现在也没有醒过来。”亮子对小强说。

“那个，我怎么知道这个人会这么弱啊！”

“算了等一下长老要过来，你去准备一些水”

没一会小强就把水准备好。

过了半个多小时左右，那个身穿铠甲的人跟在一个老头后面，老头头发和胡子全是白的，穿着一身的长袍，陂有一翻仙风道骨的感觉。

“赵长老，亮子他们抓到的那个人就关在那牢笼里。”

“庄平，你们查出那个人是什么人了吗？”长老没有停下脚步也没回头问道。

“回长老，我们查不出来，不过看他一身打扮好像不是我们这的人。”

“你的意思是？”

“是的，他就这么莫名其妙的就出现在瀑布那，好像是凭空出现的一样。”

“亮子，把他弄醒”

长老和这个叫庄平的人来到牢笼前，庄平让亮子把苏行枫弄醒。

“哗....”

一大漂水冲击着苏行枫的脸，一下就把他浇醒了过来。

“啊！！嗯！这是哪？....你们是什么人？”

苏行枫醒后感觉全身疼痛着，但是他还是忍着，因为他发现自己好像被囚禁了，四周查看了一下，发现只有四个人在牢笼外站在那盯着他，本来他第一个反应是立马回地球去的，但是他看向那四个人好像没什么敌意，他也就平复了一下心情，等再有危险再回也不迟。

而亮子他们几个听了苏行枫说的话后，一面懵逼，这是什么也听不懂啊！但是那长老听到后吃了一惊，然后用很生疏的话语问了一句。

“你系冲拿力来？”

苏行枫听了后反应了很长时间才知道，这老头说的是什么。

“你们是地球人？而且还是中国的？”

苏行枫实再是搞不明白了，这好端端的怎么就出现了会说国语的老家伙？而且这些人怎么就像是古代人一样的着装？

“庄平，你去配一副‘开智汤’给他喝，他不懂我们的话”长老只和苏行枫对话了一小段就知道怎么回事了。

庄平听到长老说的话也明白了怎么回事，他来到大厅后一个房间，里面墙壁上全是一格格的草药，和中药房一样，在格子上刻着药名，只不过这文字太过复杂看不懂。

庄平把一些药抓好后，用一个石碗装着，然后捣碎倒入一个小砂锅中冲上水，点上火熬了几十分钟倒入一个陶碗，最后还往药汤中吐了一口口水端了出去。

“亮子，把他带出来把这药汤给他服了”

亮子把牢笼说：

“你把这个喝下去，到时候就可以和我们对话了。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Su Xingfeng has been in a coma for a day and still hasn't woken up.

"Xiaoqiang, you are too harsh! This guy hasn't woken up yet." Liangzi said to Xiaoqiang.

"Well, how did I know this person would be so weak!"

"Forget it, wait until the elder comes over. Go prepare some water."

After a while, Xiaoqiang prepared the water.

After more than half an hour, the man in armor followed an old man. The old man had white hair and beard. He was wearing a long robe and had an air of immortality on his face.

"Elder Zhao, the person Liangzi and the others captured is in that cage."

"Zhuang Ping, have you found out who that person is?" the elder asked without stopping or looking back.

"Return to the elder, we can't find out, but the way he is dressed doesn't seem to be from us."

"What do you mean?"

"Yes, he just appeared at the waterfall out of nowhere, as if he appeared out of thin air."

"Ryoko, wake him up"

The elder and the man named Zhuang Ping came to the cage, and Zhuang Ping asked Liangzi to wake up Su Xingfeng.

"Wow..."

A large amount of water hit Su Xingfeng's face, waking him up instantly.

"Ah!! Well! Where is this? ...Who are you?"

After Su Xingfeng woke up, he felt pain all over his body, but he still endured it because he found that he seemed to be imprisoned. He looked around and found that there were only four people standing outside the cage staring at him. Originally, his first reaction was to return to Earth immediately, but when he looked at the four people, they seemed to have no hostility, so he calmed down, and it would not be too late to return when there is another danger.

After Liangzi and the others heard what Su Xingfeng said, they were confused. They couldn't understand anything!But the elder was surprised when he heard it, and then asked in a very unfamiliar language.

"Are you coming to charge for strength?"

Su Xingfeng took a long time to realize what the old man was talking about.

"Are you from Earth? And you're from China?"

Su Xingfeng couldn't figure it out anymore. Why did an old guy who could speak Mandarin appear among such a good person?And why do these people dress like ancient people?

"Zhuang Ping, go and prepare a cup of 'Kai Zhi Soup' for him to drink. He doesn't understand what we say." The elder only had a short conversation with Su Xingfeng before he knew what was going on.

Zhuang Ping understood what was going on after hearing what the elder said. He came to a room at the back of the hall. The walls were covered with grids of herbal medicines. Just like in a Chinese medicine pharmacy, the names of the medicines were engraved on the grids, but the text was too complicated to understand.

After Zhuang Ping grabbed some medicine, he put it in a stone bowl, then mashed it and poured it into a small casserole with water. He lit the fire and simmered it for dozens of minutes, poured it into a pottery bowl, and finally spit into the medicine soup and took it out.

"Liangzi, bring him out and give him this medicinal soup."

Liangzi put the cage in his hands and said:

"Drink this, and then you can talk to us."
